The Cua computer-server (HTTP/WS + MCP on :8000) driving the local desktop
through the embedded Cua Driver — the guest service a Cua Fleet pool probes for
readiness (/status on 8000). Installed as a Python venv under
/opt/cua-computer-server and started by a systemd user unit in the desktop
session. Verifiable on the built image: the venv's python and the unit file are
present, and the unit starts the server with the driver backend.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | create the computer-server venv and install cua-computer-server with the driver backend |
| `run` | write and enable the computer-server user unit (:8000, embedded driver on the desktop) |
| `check` | the computer-server venv python exists |
| `check` | the computer-server unit runs the driver backend on :8000 (the Cua Fleet readiness contract) |
